facts.fact: Martal's 2026 cold email benchmark analysis reports a global average cold email response rate of 3.43%.
facts.quote: The global average cold email response rate is 3.43%, based on benchmark analysis of billions of interactions

facts.fact: Per the cited benchmark analysis, high-performing cold email campaigns can reach 8% to 10% response rates when targeting and personalization are tight.
facts.quote: high-performing campaigns can clear 8% to 10% when targeting and personalization are tight

facts.fact: In one practitioner test discussed in 2026, replacing a direct meeting ask with a value-first offer raised reply rates from 0.8% to 3% to 4%, per Prospeo's cited test.
facts.quote: replacing a direct meeting ask with a value-first offer increased reply rates from 0.8% to 3% to 4%

facts.fact: Saleshandy's 2026 sending guidance recommends warming a new sending domain for 2 to 3 weeks before cold outreach.
facts.quote: warmed properly for the recommended 2 to 3 week period

facts.quote: CTV ad spend reached $33 billion in 2025, up from $26 billion in 2024

facts.fact: Per growleads.io, a third-party source, signal-first outreach campaigns triggered by buying signals can produce 4x to 8x higher reply rates than volume-based outreach.
facts.quote: Signal-first outreach data from 2024 to 2026 shows that campaigns triggered by buying signals can produce 4x to 8x higher reply rates than volume-based outreach

facts.fact: Adwave describes itself as creating and running ads for TV, search, and social.
facts.quote: Adwave creates and runs ads for TV, search, and social.

facts.fact: According to a third-party benchmark cited by Adwave (yourmarketingbowl.com), cold emails in the 101 to 200 word range achieve the best response rate at 6.8%.
facts.quote: Emails in the 101 to 200 word range achieve the best response rate at 6.8%

facts.fact: According to the same third-party benchmark cited by Adwave, cold emails over 600 words perform far worse than shorter emails, with no specific response rate given.
facts.quote: overly long emails over 600 words perform far worse

facts.fact: Adwave states that most practitioners still favor keeping first-touch cold emails under 125 words.
facts.quote: most practitioners still favor keeping first touches under 125 words

facts.fact: Adwave states that most practitioners still favor cold email subject lines under 7 words.
According to the third-party benchmark cited by Adwave, most cold email replies come from follow-ups 2 through 4, and three follow-up messages are often the sweet spot.
facts.quote: Most replies come from follow-ups 2 through 4, and three follow-up messages are often the sweet spot in practice

facts.fact: Adwave's own CTV advertising benchmarks report that video completion rates average 90% to 97% for CTV ads.
